description: A Kivy application demonstrating a customizable TabbedPanel widget with various header types, animated tab switching, and dynamic tab position changes.

classes.name: StandingHeader
classes.description: Custom header class for tabbed panel, inherits from TabbedPanelHeader.

classes.name: CloseableHeader
classes.description: Custom header class with close button, inherits from TabbedPanelHeader.

classes.name: Tp
classes.description: Subclass of TabbedPanel with animated tab switching.

classes.name: PanelLeft
classes.description: Tab panel positioned on the left, inherits from Tp.

classes.name: PanelRight
classes.description: Tab panel positioned on the right, inherits from Tp.

classes.name: TabShowcase
classes.description: Main layout class containing method to show and change tabs.

classes.name: TestTabApp
classes.description: Kivy application class that builds and runs the TabShowcase layout.

methods.name: switch_to
methods.description: Overrides tab switch to animate transition.

methods.name: add_header
methods.description: Adds a new closeable header tab.

methods.name: show_tab
methods.description: Displays the tab panels and cycles their positions.
